high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "readingroomindia." The post features a photograph of a plate of food, specifically what appears to be a dish of rava idli served with chutney and sambar on the side. The dish is presented on a white plate, and the background is dark, which makes the food stand out prominently. The text accompanying the image provides information about the Maiya family, who opened a department store selling instant food mixes during the Emergency period in India. The first product they introduced was the rava idli mix in polypacks.
